title: Buckling and Postbuckling Behavior of Stiffened Composite Panels Loaded in Compression
abstract: A modified arc length method combined with the progressive failure model was used in the nonlinear finite element method. The finite element program was applied to stiffened composite panels under axial compression, and buckling and postbuckling behavior of the panels was characterized. The web and the lower part of the cap of stiffener were favricated by the continuous plies of the skin for cocuring the stiffened panel
